question.problem:
Determine the number of pivot columns of the matrix $D,$ given by

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 4 & -7 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & 0 & 20 & -35 & 24\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
First, we need to convert $D$ to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}D & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 4 & -7 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & 0 & 20 & -35 & 24\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-5){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 4 & -7 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Looking at the row echelon form, we see that $D$ has $3$ pivots, and therefore the number of pivot columns is $3.$
